outlet: The Spokesman-Review, Amanda Sullender, "Newport Hospital plans 3-story expansion if $51 million bond passes on August ballot" (2026-04-20)
notes: Three-story addition, 60% approval, $1.47 per $1,000, 4.75-5.5% interest; ER about 10,000 patients a year in space for seven; about 30% of patients live in Idaho; up to $500 bill waiver for district taxpayers.
